frozen: 2026-10-25; confirmed by the user before any implementation or any run on data
implemented_in: v0.5.0-dev (not yet written); prerequisite: v0.4.1 fixes of review R1-R5 and R6 (full-assignment semantics)

user_confirmations.1_scope: option B is the official scope; option A is a comparator only
user_confirmations.2_span_rule: order-independent SVD truncation (S1) is official; greedy acceptance (S1') is a comparator only
user_confirmations.3_budget_rule: proposal R2 (forced dropping of directions) is removed; superseded by the dimension remark of S2
user_confirmations.4_review_R6: tracking ambiguity uses the full-assignment definition

parameters.g: raw_class_weight of the baseline config (0.90); the only numerical parameter
parameters.parameter_origin: lambda_band and almost_primary_lambda_max are taken unchanged from harden_v1.json T6_near_short

S0_scope.official: option_B: S1-S4 act in every analyse_size call (integer sectors N5-12, stageB, sensitivity variants, T3 shrunk variants)
S0_scope.comparator_A: S1-S3 only inside sectors flagged overcomplete by proposal R0 (harden_v1 T1 span_triage); all other sectors keep the v0.3.5 construction
S0_scope.selection_basis: structural: the near-duplicate inflation of w_D is one numerical mechanism independent of whether a sector is overcomplete; not chosen from dry-run results or paper labels

S1_descendant_span.H: column concatenation of all family blocks B_f on this (pair, L); each B_f from _orth_top with NULL_SV = 0.3 (unchanged)
S1_descendant_span.rule: SVD H = U S V^T; keep left singular vectors with s_i^2 >= 1 - g; D = their span (replaces _orth(hstack, rtol=1e-6))
S1_descendant_span.provenance: for every dropped singular direction record its loadings V_i on the family columns (parent pid, level n, L') -> descendant_span_dropped.csv
S1_descendant_span.comparator_S1_prime: greedy acceptance in order (level n asc, parent Delta asc, singular value desc within a family); accept u iff ||(1-Pi_A) u||^2 >= 1 - g; report only levels whose class differs from S1

S2_conflict.principal_angles: singular values of Q^T D; cos^2 theta_i = s_i^2 with principal pairs (p_i, d_i)
S2_conflict.conflict: every pair with cos^2 theta_i >= g; D' = D without d_i; Q = Q_clean (+) span{p_i}; C = span{p_i, d_i}
S2_conflict.dimension_remark: d_P + d_D > n_s forces an intersection (cos^2 = 1) and hence a conflict; overcomplete is a reporting flag only
S2_conflict.conflict_pair_mode: projected primary mode m with weight on span{p_i} >= 1 - g; not certified P until S3
S2_conflict.forbidden: orthogonalising D against Q (or Q against D) and declaring a winner
raw_level_order: otherwise v0.3.5 unclassifiable / nonprimary / mixed rules with w_P = w(Q), w_D = w(D')

definitions.pass_old: (guarded AND w(Q) >= g) OR w(D) >= g

S3_resolution.a_cross_copy: another (sA,sB) copy of the same phys_level_key lies in a conflict-free sector and is primary or descendant under S2 -> supports that side

b_K2_prediction.evaluated_on: the conflicting descendant direction d_i (not on the primary mode)
b_K2_prediction.precondition: d_i supported on guarded sources only; otherwise no evidence
b_K2_prediction.parent: family with the largest projection of d_i gives (Delta0, L0, n)

S3_resolution.c_window: fixed T3 (v0.4.1); unstable counts as opposing both sides
S3_resolution.decision: resolved to a side iff >= 1 item supports it, no item supports the other side, and (c) does not oppose; labels primary_resolved / descendant_resolved with the evidence used; otherwise stays ambiguous
S3_resolution.disclosure: count of cases resolved by (b) alone is reported separately; if they dominate, the appendix states it

S4_propagation.phys_merge: worst status over all copies of a phys_id
S4_propagation.tracks: a track with any unresolved conflict_pair point has status conflict
S4_propagation.ope: rows whose X or Z is an unresolved conflict_pair mode: identity ambiguous, publishable = false

dry_run_acceptance.case_report: 24 same-copy dual passes, 1 cross-copy split, the 4 N12 cases: dropped directions, principal angles, S3 evidence, final class
dry_run_acceptance.scope_check: sectors with all s^2 >= 1-g and no conflict: |w_D - baseline| <= 1e-12 and identical class; every other class change listed with its rule (S1/S2/S3)
unit_tests: d_P + d_D > n_s triggers a conflict
d_i with a missing K edge gives no evidence in (b)
dry_run_acceptance.sensitivity: g = 0.85 and 0.95 move the S1 cut together with g; reported, not used to choose g
dry_run_acceptance.forbidden: paper labels or agreement rates for choosing rules or options
